user.title: OCPP Charge Proxy
user.description: Connect to the OCPP Charge Proxy add-on API. The URL is detected automatically when the add-on is running; otherwise use the Hostname shown on the add-on's Info page, e.g. http://<hostname>:8099.

hassio_confirm.title: OCPP Charge Proxy Discovered
hassio_confirm.description: The OCPP Charge Proxy add-on was discovered at {url}.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to the add-on API. Ensure the add-on is running and the URL uses the Hostname from the add-on's Info page (e.g. http://e504bcf9-ocpp-charge-proxy:8099).

abort.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to the discovered add-on.

init.title: OCPP Charge Proxy Options
init.description: Optional: a power sensor to report real power instead of the simulation, and a car battery (SoC) sensor to report the car's charge level to your provider. When the SoC sensor reads 100%, the charger reports the car as full (SuspendedEV). Clear a field to stop using it.
